page_title: AI Academic Writing Tool - Comprehensive AI Research Assistant | Paperpal

summary.name: Paperpal
summary.one_liner: Paperpal is an AI academic writing tool that combines grammar checking, paraphrasing, plagiarism checking, citation generation and source-grounded research chat for researchers and students.
use_cases: Polishing English in a research manuscript before journal submission
Checking a thesis or paper for similarity before institutional review
Generating APA, MLA or Vancouver citations
Finding and summarising research articles for a literature review
Asking questions of uploaded PDFs and references
Checking a manuscript against journal formatting guidelines
summary.what_it_does: Paperpal offers grammar and tone suggestions trained on scholarly edits, and an AI paraphraser that restructures sentences and can reduce word count while keeping meaning. It includes a plagiarism check that compares text against a stated 99B+ sources. Its Research feature lets users upload references and PDFs, ask questions, and get cited findings from a stated 300M+ articles, and auto-generate citations in 10,000+ styles including APA, MLA and Vancouver. The page also describes 30+ pre-submission checks against the language and formatting standards of 1,500+ journals.
notable: Research workspace that answers questions from uploaded PDFs and cites findings from 300M+ articles
Journal submission checks against standards of 1,500+ journals
Claims 10,000+ citation styles including APA, MLA and Vancouver
States uploaded files stay private and are not used to train AI
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the directory listing tags it #free but the page itself does not confirm a free tier
Platform availability beyond the web is not described; the page mentions working 'where you write' without naming apps or integrations
Page is largely marketing claims (source counts, journal counts) with no independent verification given
